description: This file contains source code implementing ASN.1 object classes related to 'OtherName' and 'OtherString' as part of an ASN.1 encoder/decoder, including creation, initialization, and subtype handling functions.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_OTHERNAME
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 'OtherName' object, sequence type with fields for 'id' as an OID and 'other' as an 'OtherString'.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_OTHERSTRING
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 'OtherString' object, choice type with a possible 'kerberos' string.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscAsn1CreateOtherName(ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes an ASN.1 'OtherName' object, setting up its sequence and children.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscAsn1OtherNameCreateChildObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG index)
methods.description: Creates child objects for 'OtherName' depending on index: 'id' OID or 'other' OtherString.

methods.name: PANSC_ATTR_OBJECT AnscAsn1OtherNameCreateChildAttr(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG index)
methods.description: Creates attribute objects for children based on index.

methods.name: PCHAR AnscAsn1OtherNameGetChildName(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG index)
methods.description: Returns the name string for a child element based on index.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscAsn1CreateOtherString(ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes an ASN.1 'OtherString' choice object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscAsn1OtherStringCreateSelection(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG index)
methods.description: Creates a specific subtype ('kerberos' or default) for the 'OtherString' choice based on index.

methods.name: PCHAR AnscAsn1OtherStringGetSelectionName(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG selType)
methods.description: Returns the name of the selection type ('kerberos') based on selector.

methods.name: PANSC_ATTR_OBJECT AnscAsn1OtherStringCreateSelectionAttr(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG selType)
methods.description: Creates attribute objects for selection options, if applicable.

methods.name: BOOLEAN AnscAsn1OtherStringGetChoiceTagValue(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG uIndex,PASN_OBJECT_FORM_TYPE pAttr,PULONG pTagValue)
methods.description: Returns whether a choice tag value can be obtained; always returns FALSE in this implementation.
